name: Mythix Utilities
description: Useful Geometry Dash gameplay utilities in the pause menu.

no-particles.name: No Particles
no-particles.description: Hides Cocos particle-system effects while playing a level.

panel-keybind.name: Toggle Mythix Utilities Panel
panel-keybind.description: Global shortcut to open or close the Mythix Utilities panel.

startpos-prev-keybind.name: Previous Start Position
startpos-prev-keybind.description: Move to the previous Start Position.

startpos-next-keybind.name: Next Start Position
startpos-next-keybind.description: Move to the next Start Position.

panel-fade-animation.name: Panel Fade Animation
panel-fade-animation.description: Fade the Mythix Utilities panel in whenever it opens.

panel-accent-hue.name: Panel Accent Hue
panel-accent-hue.description: Hue used by the Mythix Utilities panel accent color slider.

rate-levels.name: Rate Levels
rate-levels.description: Adds a local-only fake rating button to level info menus. Nothing is submitted to Geometry Dash.
